cases.name: fetch-click
cases.html:
<!DOCTYPE html><style>body{margin:0}#b{width:100px;height:40px}</style><button id=b>go</button><script>
let frames = 0; (function tick() { frames++; requestAnimationFrame(tick); })();
const R = []; let S;
const start = () => { S = { f: frames, t: performance.now() }; };
const done = (tag) => { R.push([tag, frames - S.f, Math.round((performance.now() - S.t) * 10) / 10]); };
const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const doFetch = (tag, next) => { start(); fetch('x.txt').then((r) => r.text()).then(() => { done(tag); if (next) next(); }); };
const doXhr = (tag, next) => { start(); const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', 'x.txt'); x.onload = () => { done(tag); if (next) next(); }; x.send(); };
let imgN = 0;
const doImg = (tag, next) => { start(); const i = new Image(); i.onload = () => { done(tag); if (next) next(); }; i.src = 'x.svg?' + (imgN++); document.body.appendChild(i); };
let scrN = 0;
const doScript = (tag, next) => { start(); window.__cb = () => { done(tag); if (next) next(); }; const s = document.createElement('script'); s.src = 'x.js?' + (scrN++); document.body.appendChild(s); };
const chain = (fn, n, tag) => { let i = 0; const step = () => { if (i < n) { i++; fn(tag + i, step); } }; step(); };
b.addEventListener('click', () => doFetch('fetch-click'));
</script>
